pairsWith.noteUz: 13-14-unitlar (Join in the Fun!, Live and Let Live) bo'yicha nazorat testi: ko'chirma gap (said/told/asked if/where), -ing / to-infinitive (stop, can't stand, remember, couldn't help), bayram va hayvonlar so'zlari, yo'l ko'rsatish.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 7 - Units 13-14 (81-bet, PDF 71). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 7' va 'Units 13-14'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 It was the best party I've ...... been to. 2 "How ...... do you go there?" "Twice a week." 3 She asked me ...... I lived. 4 Are you ...... in coming to the cinema? 5 "I can do that," she ...... to me. 6 "What time shall we meet?" "Well, not later ...... five." 7 The mayor will ...... a speech tomorrow evening. 8 We can't ...... to go to the rock concert. 9 I'm sorry, but I won't be able to ...... it to your party. 10 Are you ready ...... your test? 11 Go down Green Street and ...... the first turning on your left. 12 I couldn't ...... it when I saw my favourite singer appear on stage. 13 Will you give me a ...... with the dishes? 14 He was wearing a hat to protect himself ...... the sun. 15 I am looking ...... to going on holiday. 16 The cinema is about 50 metres down the street ...... your left. 17 What was it ...... at the concert? 18 Steve went to the fancy-dress party ...... a pilot. 19 He asked ...... I knew Steve. 20 I can't ...... listening to rock music. I just hate it.
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Stop ...... please. I can't work. A talking B to talk C talk. 2 I couldn't ...... laughing at his costume. A stand B mind C help. 3 Remember ...... a jacket with you. It may be cold. A to taking B to take C taking. 4 A lot of animals are facing ...... nowadays. A wild B extinction C survival. 5 He can't stand ...... to pop music. A to listen B listen C listening. 6 Stop ...... your whistle, please. A blowing B banging C playing. 7 This gift will ...... you good luck. A show B bring C give. 8 He had never seen a tiger ...... . A before B ago C after. 9 "I haven't seen him lately," he ...... me. A asked B said C told. 10 Look at him! He's ...... a flag. A matching B waving C flying.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: Excuse me. ...... supermarket near here? B: Yes, there is. It's in Green Street. 2 A: ...... the party? B: It was great. 3 A: ...... at the rock concert? B: Over three thousand people. 4 A: ...... to come to the circus? It'll be fun. B: OK. What time? 5 A: ...... doing in your free time? B: Well, I love playing basketball.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '81'.

exercises.explanationUz:
13-14-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  KO'ChIRMA GAP: asked me WHERE I
    lived; she SAID to me; He asked
    IF I knew Steve
  BAYRAM/KONSERT: the best party
    I've EVER been to; How OFTEN?;
    INTERESTED in coming; not later
    THAN five; MAKE a speech;
    can't WAIT to go; won't be able
    to MAKE it; couldn't BELIEVE
    it; What was it LIKE?; went AS
    a pilot; can't STAND listening;
    looking FORWARD to
  YO'L KO'RSATISh: TAKE the first
    turning; ON your left
  Boshqa: ready FOR your test;
    give me a HAND; protect himself
    FROM the sun


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  = yetib bormoq, ulgurmoq.


⚠ 'A FANCY-DRESS PARTY':

  = kostyumli ziyofat.

items.textEn: It was the best party I've ___ been to.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'the best ... I've ever' = eng yaxshi ... hech qachon.

items.textEn: "How ___ do you go there?" "Twice a week."
She asked me ___ I lived.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'asked me where I lived' - ko'chirma savol.

items.textEn: Are you ___ in coming to the cinema?
"I can do that," she ___ to me.
"What time shall we meet?" "Well, not later ___ five."
The mayor will ___ a speech tomorrow evening.
We can't ___ to go to the rock concert.
I'm sorry, but I won't be able to ___ it to your party.
Are you ready ___ your test?
Go down Green Street and ___ the first turning on your left.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'take the first turning' = birinchi burilishga kiring.

items.textEn: I couldn't ___ it when I saw my favourite singer appear on stage.
Will you give me a ___ with the dishes?
He was wearing a hat to protect himself ___ the sun.
I am looking ___ to going on holiday.
The cinema is about 50 metres down the street ___ your left.
What was it ___ at the concert?
Steve went to the fancy-dress party ___ a pilot.
He asked ___ I knew Steve.
I can't ___ listening to rock music. I just hate it.

exercises.explanationUz:
13-14-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  -ING / TO:
  1 Stop TALKING (to'xtatmoq)
  2 couldn't HELP laughing =
    kulmasdan turolmadim
  3 Remember TO TAKE (eslab qilmoq)
  5 can't stand LISTENING
  LUG'AT:
  4 facing EXTINCTION = yo'q bo'lib
    ketish xavfida
  6 Stop BLOWING your whistle =
    hushtak chalish
  7 BRING you good luck = omad
    keltiradi
  8 had never seen a tiger BEFORE
  9 he TOLD me (told + kim)
  10 WAVING a flag = bayroq
    silkitish


⚠ 'REMEMBER TO' va 'REMEMBER -ING':

  remember TO take = olishni
  unutma; remember takING =
  olganini eslamoq.

items.textEn: Stop ___ please. I can't work.
items.uz: Gapirishni bas qiling, iltimos. Ishlay olmayapman.

items.textEn: I couldn't ___ laughing at his costume.
Remember ___ a jacket with you. It may be cold.
items.uz: Kurtka olishni unutma. Sovuq bo'lishi mumkin.

items.textEn: A lot of animals are facing ___ nowadays.
items.uz: Hozirgi kunda ko'p hayvonlar yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfida.

items.textEn: He can't stand ___ to pop music.
items.uz: U pop musiqa tinglashga chiday olmaydi.

items.textEn: Stop ___ your whistle, please.
This gift will ___ you good luck.
He had never seen a tiger ___.
items.uz: U ilgari hech qachon yo'lbars ko'rmagan edi.

items.textEn: "I haven't seen him lately," he ___ me.
Look at him! He's ___ a flag.

exercises.explanationUz:
YO'L SO'RASh, TADBIR, TAKLIF
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'Yes, there is' → IS THERE A
    supermarket near here?
  2 'It was great' → HOW WAS the
    party?
  3 'Over three thousand people' →
    HOW MANY PEOPLE WERE THERE at
    the concert?
  4 'OK. What time?' → WOULD YOU
    LIKE / DO YOU WANT to come to
    the circus?
  5 'I love playing basketball' →
    WHAT DO YOU LIKE doing in your
    free time?


⚠ 'OVER THREE THOUSAND':

  = uch mingdan ortiq.

items.textEn: A: Excuse me. ___ supermarket near here?  B: Yes, there is. It's in Green Street.
A: ___ the party?  B: It was great.
A: ___ at the rock concert?  B: Over three thousand people.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Son javobi → 'How many people were there?'

items.textEn: A: ___ to come to the circus? It'll be fun.  B: OK. What time?
A: ___ doing in your free time?  B: Well, I love playing basketball.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'What do you like doing?' → 'I love playing ...'

patterns.formula: KIM + asked (me) + where/if + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: She asked me where I lived. He asked if I knew Steve.
patterns.exampleUz: U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi. U Stivni bilaman-yo'qmi deb so'radi.

patterns.formula: stop / can't stand / couldn't help + V-ing;  remember + to V
patterns.exampleEn: Stop talking. I can't stand listening to pop music. Remember to take a jacket.
patterns.exampleUz: Gapirishni bas qiling. Pop musiqa tinglashga chiday olmayman. Kurtka olishni unutma.

patterns.formula: Go down X Street and take the first turning on your left.
patterns.exampleEn: Go down Green Street and take the first turning on your left.
patterns.exampleUz: Grin ko'chasi bo'ylab boring va chapdagi birinchi burilishga kiring.

patterns.formula: It was the best ... I've ever + V3
patterns.exampleEn: It was the best party I've ever been to.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu men borgan eng yaxshi ziyofat edi.
